entities.name: João Lins Vieira Cansanção de Sinimbu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: João Lins Vieira Cansanção de Sinimbu, Viscount of Sinimbu was a Brazilian politician. He was President of the Council of Ministers from 5 January 1878 until 28 March 1880. He served as the President of the Senate from 1887 to 1888.

entities.summary: João Lins Vieira Cansanção de Sinimbu, Viscount of Sinimbu was a Brazilian politician. He was President of the Council of Ministers from 5 January 1878 until 28 March 1880. He served as the President of the Senate from 1887 to 1888.
